question: Should the Discord and Feishu channel owners adopt these exact Markdown and parser-output assertions as long-term contracts before future shared-Markdown work proceeds?
rationale: The new tests do not change runtime behavior, but they make channel-specific output invariants durable; the protected maintainer label indicates that this ownership decision should remain human-controlled.

options.title: Confirm the contracts
options.body: Accept the assertions after the relevant channel owner confirms that the preserved bytes and block structure are intentional compatibility behavior.

options.title: Narrow or revise assertions
options.body: Keep only behavior that the channel owners intend to support and remove assertions that lock incidental renderer or parser details.

recommendation.title: Confirm the contracts
recommendation.body: Accept the assertions after the relevant channel owner confirms that the preserved bytes and block structure are intentional compatibility behavior.
